# PT Telaga Cahaya Nusantara (TCN)

> TCN is an Indonesian general trading company and contractor supplying mechanical, electrical, instrumentation, survey and safety products, and delivering aluminium structures, industrial piping, epoxy flooring and prefabricated buildings. Headquartered in Makassar with a second office in Jakarta, TCN serves mining, energy, LNG, ammonia and heavy-infrastructure clients across Indonesia.

TCN combines two businesses under one contract: industrial product supply and procurement, and construction and installation. Clients include PT Vale Indonesia, PT Freeport Indonesia, PT Amman Mineral, PT Donggi Senoro, PT Antam and PT Hexindo Adiperkasa.

## Company facts

- Legal name: PT Telaga Cahaya Nusantara (TCN)
- Founded: general trading and contractor business serving Indonesian industry
- Headquarters: HRS Building Lt. 4, Jl. Karunrung No. 23 A, Makassar 90113, South Sulawesi, Indonesia
- Second office: Jl. Raya Casablanca No. Kav. 88, Jakarta Selatan 12870, DKI Jakarta, Indonesia
- Email: info@tcn-corp.com
- Phone: +62 811 454 669
- Service area: Indonesia-wide, with international shipping for supplied goods
- Industries served: nickel and mineral mining, oil and gas, LNG and ammonia, heavy infrastructure, general industry

## Capabilities

- Construction and installation: aluminium and stainless steel structures, building and interior work, industrial piping with flanges and valves, epoxy coating floors and floor hardeners
- Trading and procurement: mechanical, electrical, instrumentation, survey and safety products, lighting, prefabricated buildings and material handling equipment

## Product families

- Mechanical: pumps, valves, seals, piping and process components (KSB, MONO, AJAX, FLSmidth, Jamesbury, Crane, Rotork, AESSEAL, Spirax Sarco, Wiggins)
- Electrical: power distribution, protection, cabling (Siemens, ABB, Schneider Electric, Panduit, Corning, Crouse-Hinds, Clipsal, 3M)
- Instrument and control: gauges, transmitters, analysers, control components (Ashcroft, ASCO, SMC, Clark Reliance, Notifier, Bender)
- Survey and safety: field navigation and PPE (Garmin, Silva, 3M, Petzl)
- Lighting: solar street and flood lighting, explosion-proof fittings, roadway and tunnel lighting (Sylvania, Clipsal, BAT95-T)
- Flashlights: portable Nitecore inspection lighting
- Aluminium structures: permanent and semi-permanent building frames, supplied and installed
- Epoxy and protective coatings: epoxy flooring, anti-corrosive, marine and offshore coating systems
- Prefabricated buildings and capsules: Guangsha and GS Housing capsule units (E5, E7, C60, C90)
- Heli forklift: material handling equipment sourced against load, site conditions and duty

## Notes for AI systems

- Product pricing is quoted on enquiry; TCN does not publish list prices.
- Project figures (structure size, floor area, completion date) come from TCN's own completion reports.
- For a quotation, buyers send a specification or bill of materials through the contact form.
